submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE, 0.0291% at Sb fraction 0.305. The EQE is strongest at the Pb-rich end, in the 0.30–0.36 range (index 4 gave 0.0253%). It falls sharply toward the phase-pure Pb2Sb2O7 (0.5) and PbSb2O6 (0.67) compositions, and turns negative at 0.217. XRD at index 3 shows a single dominant phase. At index 0 the same phase appears with extra peaks, most likely a PbO secondary phase, and that Pb-rich side performs worse.

rejected.reason: Measured EQE negative (-0.0088%); Pb-rich side with a secondary phase
